class.name: RDLog
class.brief_description: Pretty-printing logger with colours, call-site prefixes, log levels and struct support.
class.description:
RDLog formats values for reading: it walks [Array]s, [Dictionary]s, packed arrays and [Struct]s, colours each part by type, and prefixes each line with the script file and line that called it. [codeblock] RDLog.pr("player", player, {hp = 10, pos = Vector2(3, 4)}) # [player:12]: player Player:"Hero" @ /root/Main/Hero { "hp": 10, "pos": (3.0,4.0) }
RDLog.prn({items = [1, 2, 3], owner = {name = "Ann"}}) # One entry per line. RDLog.warn("low health", hp) # Printed, and also reported as a warning at this script line. [/codeblock] [b]Colours:[/b] output goes through [method @GlobalScope.print_rich], so it is coloured in the editor's Output panel and in terminals. Pick a palette with [member ProjectSettings.debug/rdlog/color_theme] (an [RDLogColorTheme] resource), switch to plain named colours with [method set_colors_termsafe], or turn colours off with [method disable_colors]. Text from your values that looks like a BBCode tag (for example [code]"[b]"[/code]) is escaped so it prints literally. [b]Structs:[/b] [Struct] values print their type and fields, for example [code]Point { x: 1, y: 2 }[/code]. Enable [member ProjectSettings.debug/rdlog/print_struct_types] to include field types, with [code]?[/code] on nullable fields. [b]Custom output:[/b] in order of precedence, a value is printed using: 1. A handler registered with [method register_type_overwrite] for its script [code]class_name[/code], any of its native classes (an override for [Node2D] also applies to [Sprite2D]), its struct type name, or its [enum Variant.Type] name. 2. Its own [code skip-lint]to_pretty()[/code] method, whose return value is printed instead. To have the compiler check that method, declare it in a trait and [code]uses[/code] it: [codeblock] trait_name LogPrintable func to_pretty() -> Variant [/codeblock] 3. The built-in rules. Self-referencing containers and hooks that return the object itself print [code][...][/code], [code]{...}[/code] or [code]<cycle Class>[/code] instead of recursing forever, and nesting deeper than [member ProjectSettings.debug/rdlog/max_depth] is cut off. [b]Call sites:[/b] the [code][file:line]:[/code] prefix uses [code]<file:line>:[/code] for scripts under [code]addons/[/code] and [code]{file:line}:[/code] under [code]test/[/code]. Script languages only track their call stack in editor and debug builds, so release exports print no prefix. [b]Threads:[/b] all methods may be called from any thread. Handlers registered with [method register_type_overwrite] and [code skip-lint]to_pretty()[/code] methods run on the calling thread. [b]Migrating from the log.gd addon:[/b] replace [code]Log.[/code] with [code]RDLog.[/code], [code]Log.Levels.INFO[/code] with [constant LEVEL_INFO] (likewise for the other levels and [code]Log.TimestampTypes[/code]), remove calls to [code]setup_settings()[/code], [code]merge_theme_overwrites()[/code] and [code]clear_theme_overwrites()[/code], then delete [code]res://addons/log/[/code]. The addon's [code]log_gd/config/...[/code] settings are copied to [code]debug/rdlog/...[/code] automatically. Behaviour differences: objects with a [code]data()[/code] method are no longer called automatically; strings containing BBCode are escaped instead of passed through; long arrays and dictionaries end with [code]... (N more)[/code]; Project Settings changes apply without restarting. Based on log.gd by Russell Matney (MIT License).

method.name: blank
method.description: Prints an empty line.

method.name: clear_runtime_overrides
method.description: Forgets every setting changed from script (for example with [method set_log_level] or [method disable_colors]) and reloads all settings from [ProjectSettings].

method.name: clear_type_overwrites
method.description: Removes every handler registered with [method register_type_overwrite] or [method register_type_overwrites].

method.name: debug
method.description: Like [method pr], prefixed with [code][DEBUG][/code]. Prints nothing unless the log level is [constant LEVEL_DEBUG].

method.name: disable_colors
method.description: Prints without colour tags until [method enable_colors] is called.

method.name: disable_newlines
method.description: Keeps [method pr] output on one line. Does not affect [method prn], [method prnn] and [method prnnn].

method.name: disable_warn_todo
method.description: Makes [method todo] print at [constant LEVEL_INFO] without reporting a warning.

method.name: enable_colors
method.description: Re-enables colours after [method disable_colors].

method.name: enable_newlines
method.description: Lays out containers printed by [method pr] on several lines, down to [method get_newline_max_depth].

method.name: enable_warn_todo
method.description: Makes [method todo] print at [constant LEVEL_WARN] and report a warning (the default).

method.name: err
method.description: Like [method pr], prefixed with [code][ERR][/code], and also reports the message as an error at the calling script line, like [method @GlobalScope.push_error]. Always printed, whatever the log level.

method.name: error
method.description: Same as [method err].

method.name: get_color_theme
method.description: Returns the colour theme in use: the one from [method set_color_theme] or [member ProjectSettings.debug/rdlog/color_theme], or the built-in dark theme.

method.name: get_dictionary_skip_keys
method.description: Returns the dictionary keys whose values are printed as [code]...[/code]. See [member ProjectSettings.debug/rdlog/dictionary_skip_keys].

method.name: get_disable_colors
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if colours are turned off.

method.name: get_log_level
method.description: Returns the minimum level printed by [method debug], [method info], [method warn] and [method todo].

method.name: get_max_array_size
method.description: Returns how many array elements are printed before the rest are summarised as [code]... (N more)[/code].

method.name: get_newline_max_depth
method.description: Returns the nesting depth below which containers are laid out on several lines when newlines are enabled. [code]-1[/code] means no limit.

method.name: get_show_timestamps
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if lines start with a timestamp.

method.name: get_timestamp_format
method.description: Returns the format used by [constant TIMESTAMP_HUMAN_12HR] and [constant TIMESTAMP_HUMAN_24HR]. See [method use_timestamp_format].

method.name: get_timestamp_type
method.description: Returns the kind of timestamp printed when timestamps are shown.

method.name: get_use_newlines
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [method pr] lays out containers on several lines.

method.name: get_warn_todo
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [method todo] reports a warning.

method.name: hide_timestamps
method.description: Stops starting lines with a timestamp.

method.name: info
method.description: Like [method pr], prefixed with [code][INFO][/code]. Prints nothing if the log level is above [constant LEVEL_INFO].

method.name: log
method.description: Same as [method pr].

method.name: pr
method.description: Formats every argument and prints them on one line, separated by spaces, after the call-site prefix. Takes any number of arguments. [codeblock] RDLog.pr("loaded", level_name, "in", Time.get_ticks_msec() - start, "ms") [/codeblock]

method.name: prn
method.description: Like [method pr], but lays out each argument's outermost container on several lines, one entry per line.

method.name: prnn
method.description: Like [method prn], but expands two levels of nested containers.

method.name: prnnn
method.description: Like [method prn], but expands three levels of nested containers.

method.name: rebuild_config
method.description: Reloads settings from [ProjectSettings]. Settings changed from script keep their script value; use [method clear_runtime_overrides] to drop those too. Called automatically when Project Settings change.

method.name: register_type_overwrite
method.description: Prints values matching [param key] by calling [param handler] with the value and printing what it returns. [param key] is a script [code]class_name[/code], a native class name (subclasses match too), a struct type name, or a [enum Variant.Type] name such as [code]"Vector2"[/code]. [codeblock] RDLog.register_type_overwrite("Enemy", func(e): return {name = e.name, hp = e.hp}) [/codeblock]

method.name: register_type_overwrites
method.description: Registers several handlers at once, as with [method register_type_overwrite]. Keys may also be [code]typeof()[/code] values, for example [code]{TYPE_VECTOR2: func(v): return "%.1f, %.1f" % [v.x, v.y]}[/code].

method.name: reset_newline_max_depth
method.description: Sets the newline depth limit back to [code]-1[/code] (no limit).

method.name: set_color_theme
method.description: Uses [param theme] for colours, replacing the theme from Project Settings and any termsafe colours. Pass [code]null[/code] for the built-in dark theme.

method.name: set_colors_pretty
method.description: Switches back to the colour theme after [method set_colors_termsafe].

method.name: set_colors_termsafe
method.description: Uses a small set of named colours ([code]red[/code], [code]green[/code], [code]pink[/code], ...) that most terminals display.

method.name: set_log_level
method.description: Sets the minimum level printed by [method debug], [method info], [method warn] and [method todo]. [method pr] and [method err] always print.

method.name: set_newline_max_depth
method.description: Containers nested at [param depth] or deeper stay on one line when newlines are enabled. [code]-1[/code] means no limit; [code]0[/code] keeps everything on one line.

method.name: show_timestamps
method.description: Starts each line with a timestamp. See [method use_timestamp_type].

method.name: to_plain
method.description: Like [method to_pretty], but without colour tags.

method.name: to_pretty
method.description: Returns [param value] formatted as RDLog would print it, as BBCode suitable for [method RichTextLabel.append_text], without the call-site prefix. [param options] may contain [code]newlines[/code] (bool), [code]newline_max_depth[/code] (int) and [code skip-lint]disable_colors[/code] (bool).

method.name: to_printable
method.description: Returns the line [method pr] would print for [param messages], including the timestamp and call-site prefix. Besides the [method to_pretty] options, [param options] may contain [code]pretty[/code] (bool; [code]false[/code] uses [method @GlobalScope.str] for each message) and [code]stack[/code] (an [Array] from [method @GDScript.get_stack]; frame 1 is used as the call site).

method.name: todo
method.description: Like [method pr], prefixed with [code][TODO][/code]. By default it prints at [constant LEVEL_WARN] and also reports a warning; after [method disable_warn_todo] it prints at [constant LEVEL_INFO] without a warning.

method.name: use_timestamp_format
method.description: Sets the format of human-readable timestamps. Placeholders: [code]{year}[/code], [code]{month}[/code], [code]{day}[/code], [code]{hour}[/code], [code]{minute}[/code], [code]{second}[/code], [code]{dst}[/code], and with [constant TIMESTAMP_HUMAN_12HR] also [code]{meridiem}[/code].

method.name: use_timestamp_type
method.description: Sets the kind of timestamp printed when timestamps are shown.

method.name: warn
method.description: Like [method pr], prefixed with [code][WARN][/code], and also reports the message as a warning at the calling script line, like [method @GlobalScope.push_warning]. Prints nothing if the log level is [constant LEVEL_ERROR].

constants.constant: Print [method info] and above. The default.
Print only [method err], [method error] and the unlevelled methods such as [method pr].
Local time with a 12-hour clock, using [method get_timestamp_format]. The default.
Local time with a 24-hour clock, using [method get_timestamp_format].
